TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING AGENDA
  THURSDAY SEPTEMBER 21, 2023 9:30 AM
  SAN DIMAS COUNCIL CHAMBER CONFERENCE ROOM
  245 EAST BONITA AVENUE

PLEASE NOTE: Traffic Safety Committee is an Advisory Committee which is open to the public. In order to conduct the
meeting effectively and fairly, participants will be given an opportunity to discuss their concerns within a 3-minute time
allotment. This timing has been instituted to ensure everyone wishing to speak has the same opportunity. We appreciate
your understanding and cooperation with this policy.

If you have any additional questions, please contact staff at (909) 394-6240 or email at publicworks@sandimasca.gov.

 INTRODUCTIONS

 DISCUSSION ITEMS

#09-23-01  PUDDINGSTONE DR (LA TRI SERIES)
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review traffic control plans for the LA Tri Series event scheduled for Sunday,
October 1, 2023. This event will temporarily close portions of Puddingstone Dr, Cannon Ave, Walnut Ave and
San Dimas Ave from 6:00am thru 11:00am.

#09-23-02  AVENIDA ENTRADA AND AVENIDA LADERA
REQUEST FROM RESIDENT, to review and consider installation of red curb on southwest corner of Avenida
Ladera at Avenida Entrada to assist with perceived line of sight concerns for vehicles making a left turn onto
Avenida Entrada.

#09-23-03  226 CALLE ROSA
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review and consider installation of red curb near the LA County’s sewer pump
station to eliminate parked cars in front of gates and impede on working on the sewer pump.

#09-23-04  AVENIDA ENTRADA
REQUEST FROM RESIDENT, to review and consider additional enforcement for cars speeding and running
stop signs on Avenida Entrada.

#09-23-05  SAINTS COURT (RECREATION CENTER CROSSWALK)
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review and consider installation of designated crosswalk for Recreation Center
patrons from the SDHS parking lot.

#09-23-06  TEAGUE DRIVE (CANYON CREEK VILLAGE HOA)
REQUEST FROM HOA, to review and consider installation of red curb at sidewalk entrances only at 4 specific
locations.

#09-23-07  SAN DIMAS AVE (VETERANS DAY)
REQUEST FROM STAFF, to review site plans and set up for the San Dimas HEROES event scheduled for
Saturday, November 11, 2023 from 4:00pm – 5:00pm. This event does not close any portions of city streets.

#09-23-08 1009 W GLADSTONE (W/O TRACKS)
REQUEST FROM RESIDENT, to review traffic concerns on Gladstone relating to driveway access.

 CONTINUED ITEMS
  Traffic Safety Committee Agenda
 For the Meeting of September 21, 2023  Page 2

  #06-23-04  MAVERICK DR AND BUTTERFIELD AVE
  REQUEST FROM RESIDENT, to review and consider creation and implementation of permit parking district for the Maverick
  Dr and Butterfield Ave area residents.
  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

  ADJOURNMENT

  Notice Regarding Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need assistance
  to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (909) 394-6216. Early notification
  before the meeting you wish to attend will make it possible for the City to make reasonable arrangements to
  ensure accessibility to this meeting [28 CFR 35.102-35.104 ADA Title II].
Copies of documents distributed for the meeting are available in alternative formats upon request. Any writings or
documents provided to the Traffic Safety Committee regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for
public review Monday through Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. and on Fridays from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at the Public
Works Department. In addition, most documents are posted on the City’s website at www.sandimasca.gov.

Posting Statement: I declare under penalty of perjury that on September 14th, 2023, I posted a true and correct copy of
this agenda on the bulletin board in the Civic Center Plaza of City Hall at 245 E. Bonita Ave., and on the City’s
website www.sandimasca.gov/agendas-minutes/ as required by law.

  Rhonda Abangan
September 14, 2023  Rhonda Abangan, Administrative Secretary
